confirmed.fact: The 29 October renewal charge ran twice, starting at 13:00 UTC.
The second charge came from Brewvane's own renewal job running twice. There is no sign of outside access to payment details.
The second run was stopped at 14:05 UTC and no duplicate charge has gone through since.
1,912 subscribers were charged twice. Nobody was charged three times.
confirmed.confirmed_by: finance lead, from the payment processor's export

confirmed.fact: Every duplicate charge will be refunded in full, with no need to ask.
Subscribers can cancel at any time from their account page.

unconfirmed.item: Why the renewal job ran twice (a payment settings change that morning is suspected)
The date refunds are issued and how long banks take to show them
unconfirmed.checking: finance lead, with the payment processor

unconfirmed.item: Whether Brewvane will cover bank fees caused by the duplicate charge

not_known: How many customers paid a bank fee because of the duplicate charge

approvals_and_legal.counsel: No hard trigger applies. Money was taken in error, so counsel review is recommended before the holding statement, the customer email and the full statement go out.
questions_for_counsel: Do any refund or billing-error rules set a deadline or a required wording for the refund to the 1,912 customers?
Does covering bank fees, if the founder decides to, need particular wording?

We stopped the duplicate charges at 14:05 UTC, and every duplicate charge will be refunded in full. You don't need to contact us to get it. pieces.legal: counsel review recommended (money taken in error)

pieces.text:
Where things stand at 19:00 UTC (15:00 ET): our 29 October renewal charge ran twice for 1,912 subscribers. It came from our own renewal job, with no sign of outside access to payment details. The duplicate run was stopped at 14:05 UTC and every duplicate charge will be refunded in full. We don't yet know why the job ran twice or when refunds land.
If anyone asks: "We've posted an update at brewvane.example/update."
Reporters go to the head of customer experience. Customers go to the support lead's queue.
Please don't post about this on your own accounts.
Next internal update: 21:00 UTC (17:00 ET).
pieces.send_with: slack post_message, in the same minutes as the holding statement

pieces.piece: Customer email to the 1,912 subscribers charged twice
pieces.subject: We charged you twice. Your refund is coming
pieces.text:
Your 29 October renewal was charged twice. That was our mistake, and we're sorry.

Our renewal system ran the charge a second time. There is no sign that anyone outside Brewvane got to your card details: this was our own system repeating a payment.

We stopped it at 14:05 UTC (10:05 ET), and we'll refund the second charge in full. You don't need to do anything. We'll email you again when the refund has been issued, with the date it should reach your account.

If the extra charge caused you a problem with your bank, reply to this email and tell us. We read every reply.

Updates: brewvane.example/update

The Brewvane team

questions.question: Was I charged twice? Am I affected?
questions.answer: If your 29 October renewal shows two charges, yes. 1,912 subscribers were charged twice. Every duplicate charge will be refunded in full, and we'll email each of them.

questions.question: When do I get my refund?
questions.answer: Every duplicate charge will be refunded in full, with no need to ask. Our finance lead is confirming the issue date with the payment processor. We'll share it once it's confirmed and email each customer when it is issued.

questions.question: Why did this happen?
questions.answer: Our renewal job ran twice. Our engineering lead is confirming why, and we'll share the cause once it is confirmed.

questions.question: Will you cover my bank fee?
questions.answer: Our founder is deciding this now and we'll say in the 21:00 UTC (17:00 ET) update. Until then, please reply to our email or DM us with the fee so we have it on record.

questions.question: Is my card safe? Were you hacked?
questions.answer: Yes, as far as we can see. The second charge came from our own renewal job running twice, and there is no sign of outside access to payment details.

questions.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
questions.answer: Yes, any time from your account page, and your duplicate charge is refunded either way. We'd understand it, and we'd like the chance to put this right.

questions.question: Were people charged three times?
questions.answer: No. The payment processor's records show 1,912 subscribers charged twice and nobody charged three times.

request.request: Hello, I'm writing from Brewvane Coffee Co. about your story published at 17:30 UTC today. It says thousands of subscribers were charged three times.
